mara-csm: Heads-up — LyricWare needs a temporary surge window on APAC edge for a marketing spike tomorrow. Request: raise per-minute token allowance to 600k for the account and add CIDR exemption for their egress 203.0.113.0/24. Window: 2026-03-22 08:00–10:00 SGT (UTC+8). Can infra/ops set a time-limited rule and schedule automatic rollback? cc @alex-infra @sam-eng :pray:
sam-eng: Thanks — can you paste the account id and confirm expected traffic profile (sustained RPS, burst RPS)? Also need exact UTC window so we can schedule config change and smoke tests.
mara-csm: Account: LW-8721. Confirmed window in UTC: 2026-03-22 00:00–02:00 UTC. Expected sustained ~400 RPS, short bursts up to 1200 RPS for ~5–10s. No auth changes requested, just CIDR + rate override.
ops-bot: Ticket CS-51234 created and assigned to infra. ETA for change: 90m. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/CS-51234 :spiral_calendar:
alex-infra: I can apply a windowed rule on apac-edge. Plan: add 203.0.113.0/24 to apac-edge-trusted for 2 hours, set per-customer rate override to 600k/min, and schedule rollback at 02:05 UTC. Will run smoke at T-10m. Need final confirmation to proceed with smoke at 23:50 UTC.
mara-csm: Confirmed — run smoke at 23:50 UTC. I'll stand by and share LyricWare contact for live testing.
sam-eng: Quick note — high RPS may increase KV cache churn. Recommend monitoring KV hit-rate and throttling metrics; if needed, we can route overflow to burst-queue to protect other tenants. @lina-ps can you confirm whether LyricWare will accept any model variant suggestions if we need to reduce memory pressure?
lina-ps: Chatted with their infra lead — they strongly prefer no model change during the campaign. They'll accept temporary throttling instead of model swaps. I'll keep them informed.
nick-legal: FYI — temporary network exemptions okay under current SLA. No changes to data residency or retention. I'll add a short note to CS-51234 for compliance trace.
alex-infra: Applied rules to staging for smoke at 23:50 UTC, will promote to prod at 00:00 UTC if smoke passes. Example config applied: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/configs/apply -d '{"account":"LW-8721","cidr":"203.0.113.0/24","rate_override_per_min":600000,"window":"2026-03-22T00:00:00Z/2026-03-22T02:00:00Z"}'` — rollback job scheduled.
mara-csm: Awesome, thanks everyone. I'll monitor and post updates in this thread during the window. :thumbsup:
